cache_provenance: post_build_attestation; caches were user-authorised before this evaluation freeze

gates.fail: either unseen mean disparity or depth MAE >=0
gates.not_confirmed: mean improves but breadth/CI/tail gate fails
gates.pass: both unseen: MAE disparity/depth CI upper<0; both specimens<0; P99/Bad/Invalid non-regression

metric_protocol.fixed_support: Zivid GT valid only; never prediction/flow/support intersection

safety_gate_protocol.efficacy: both unseen: disparity EPE and depth MAE macro-session delta<0, 95% paired bootstrap upper<0, both specimens<0
safety_gate_protocol.safety: raw identity reference has zero update harm; HUR/HPlus/NewBad must remain at or below seen-control worst plus fixed tolerance (HUR/NewBad 0.01; HPlus 0.02px), tail Bad/Invalid/P99 must not exceed raw; depth uses the same 0.01 rate tolerance and 20mm HPlus tolerance
safety_gate_protocol.verdict: PASS requires every efficacy+safety condition for both unseen; FAIL if either efficacy mean>=0 or a named safety metric increases; otherwise NOT_CONFIRMED
